newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixed at $336.90, low since April '93.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixed at $336.90, low since April '93.

text.p: Gold fixed at $336.90 per ounce on Wednesday, its lowest level since April 13, 1993.
Dealers said a fresh surge in the dollar to 34-month highs against the mark and four-year highs against the yen put pressure on bullion.
London gold fixed at $336.90, low since April =2
Selling came from gold producers anxious to protect profit margins against ever lower prices and from long-term investors finally becoming disillusioned with the yellow metal.
"It is very difficult to pick a floor for this price," a dealer said.
"There is selling every morning. It is relentless at the moment," he added.

Gold prices have been falling for most of the past year, threatened by selling from central banks and producers and by better profit opportunities for investors in the financial markets, dealers said.
